user_questions.question: (1) Opening/Closing times are Text(255); all 147 rows use 12-hour 'hh:mm AM/PM' but the agent action documents 24-hour 'HH:MM'. Should the rule A) accept both formats and reject anything else (recommended), B) convert the fields to Time type (migration, changes agent action), or C) accept only 12-hour? (2) Must overnight hours (closing after midnight) be allowed? (3) Should rows with a blank opening or closing time (e.g. a closed day) be allowed?
user_questions.simulated_answer: (1) No preference; use your recommended default. (2) Overnight hours are not needed. (3) No preference; use your recommended default.
